sentences.en: From The New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是来自《纽约时报》的迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日简报》。

sentences.en: A few days ago in Rome, Vice President J.D.
sentences.zh: 几天前在罗马，副总统J.D.

sentences.en: Vance met with the new pope.
sentences.zh: 万斯会见了新教皇。

sentences.en: And then he sat down with my colleague Ross Douthat, a Times opinion columnist and host of a new podcast called Interesting Times, for an interview about faith, immigration,
sentences.zh: 随后他与我的同事罗斯·杜塔特坐下来进行了交谈，罗斯是《时报》的观点专栏作家，也是新播客《有趣的时代》的主持人，他们讨论了信仰、移民、

sentences.en: the law, and the partisan temptation to go too far.
sentences.zh: 法律，以及党派倾向带来的过度行为。

sentences.en: Today, Ross talks us through their conversation.
sentences.zh: 今天，罗斯将为我们讲述他们的对话内容。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, May 22nd.
sentences.zh: 今天是5月22日，星期四。

sentences.en: Ross, thank you for being here.
sentences.zh: 罗斯，谢谢你来到这里。

sentences.en: I know that you've had a very long couple of days, sleepless couple of days, and we appreciate you making time.
sentences.zh: 我知道你这两天过得很漫长，几乎没怎么睡，非常感谢你抽出时间。

sentences.en: Michael, it is my pleasure and it is a privilege to be with you.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔，这是我的荣幸，能和你在一起是我的特权。

sentences.en: And I have slept two nights back at home in the United States, so I am completely rested and ready.
sentences.zh: 而且我回到美国后已经睡了两晚，所以我现在完全休息好了，准备就绪。

sentences.en: Well, just to start, tell us how this interview, which required you to leave the country and lose a lot of sleep, how it came about.
sentences.zh: 好吧，先从头说起，告诉我们这次采访是如何促成的，毕竟这需要你出国还要牺牲大量睡眠。

sentences.en: Well, so like a number of people in journalism, I have known J.D.
sentences.zh: 嗯，就像新闻界的许多人一样，我认识J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, the vice president, since long before he became the vice president, all the way back to when he was just a humble,
sentences.zh: 万斯副总统，在他成为副总统很久之前就认识了，一直追溯到他还是个谦逊的、

sentences.en: bestselling author and occasional contributor to the New York Times opinion pages.
sentences.zh: 畅销书作家，偶尔为《纽约时报》观点版撰稿的时候。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And through that connection, I convinced him to grant me an extended interview just before he became Donald Trump's vice presidential nominee.
sentences.zh: 通过这层关系，我在他成为唐纳德·特朗普的副总统候选人之前，说服他接受了我的深度采访。

sentences.en: And then a couple of months ago, I launched my own new interview podcaSt. And of course, I came back to him and said, hey, now I'm interviewing people all the time.
sentences.zh: 几个月前，我推出了自己的新访谈播客。当然，我又去找他，说，嘿，我现在经常采访别人。

sentences.en: Wouldn't you like to be interviewed again?
sentences.zh: 你愿意再接受一次采访吗？

sentences.en: And he very graciously suggested that maybe I would like to come to Rome, where he was leading the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他非常大度地建议，或许我可以去罗马，他当时正在那里率领美国

sentences.en: delegation to the inaugural mass of Pope Leo XIV, who is, of course, the first American pope.
sentences.zh: 代表团参加教皇利奥十四世的就职弥撒，当然，他是第一位美国教皇。

sentences.en: And he basically said, why don't you come to Rome and you can interview me there.
sentences.zh: 他基本上说，你为什么不来罗马，可以在那里采访我。

sentences.en: I have to imagine that's a pretty tempting offer for any journalist, period.
sentences.zh: 我不得不说，这对任何记者来说都是一个极具诱惑力的提议。

sentences.en: But for a religious Catholic like yourself, an especially tempting offer.
sentences.zh: 但对于像你这样虔诚的天主教徒来说，这更是一个特别诱人的提议。

sentences.en: Yes, it was quite a thing, actually, to be able to attend the inaugural mass.
sentences.zh: 是的，事实上，能够参加就职弥撒确实是一件了不起的事情。

sentences.en: The vice president then had a private audience with Pope Leo himself and then came directly from that to our interview.
sentences.zh: 副总统随后与利奥教皇本人进行了私人会见，然后直接从那里赶来接受我们的采访。

sentences.en: Good to see you.
sentences.zh: 很高兴见到你。

sentences.en: Hey, guys, how are you?
sentences.zh: 嘿，伙计们，你们好吗？

sentences.en: And we have set up shop inside the American embassy to the Vatican in, you know, a kind of ornate space and room.
sentences.zh: 我们在美国驻梵蒂冈大使馆内设立了临时演播室，你知道，那是一个装饰华丽的空间和房间。

sentences.en: My goal is to actually give you more than an hour or so.
sentences.zh: 我的目标是给你一个多小时的时间。

sentences.en: So we'll just go until this conversation becomes boring or until I say something really stupid.
sentences.zh: 所以我们就一直聊，直到对话变得无聊，或者直到我说出什么非常愚蠢的话为止。

sentences.en: Until we hit the UFOs and then you'll beat a hasty retreat.
sentences.zh: 直到我们聊到UFO，然后你就会匆忙撤退。

sentences.en: And just to explain, Ross, we're going to be playing large segments of your conversation with Vance in this episode because it really helps you understand how Vance thinks.
sentences.zh: 顺便解释一下，罗斯，我们这期节目会播放你与万斯对话的大量片段，因为这确实能帮助大家理解万斯的思维方式。

sentences.en: But just to understand what you're doing in this interview, what, once it's beginning, is your real overriding goal for the conversation?
sentences.zh: 但为了理解你这次采访的目的，一旦开始，你在这个对话中真正最重要的目标是什么？

sentences.en: Well,
sentences.zh: 嗯，

sentences.en: the ultimate goal for the conversation is to get a frank assessment from the vice president of what the administration is actually trying to do on some of its most controversial policies,
sentences.zh: 这次对话的最终目标是让副总统坦诚评估本届政府在一些最具争议的政策上到底在试图做什么，

sentences.en: most notably immigration and trade, what the end game is, what the actual metrics for success are and so on.
sentences.zh: 最显著的是移民和贸易，最终目标是什么，成功的实际衡量标准是什么等等。

sentences.en: But the way into that discussion starts with the place where we are and what's just happened, the inauguration of a new pope, and the fact that J.D.
sentences.zh: 但进入这个讨论的切入点是我们所处的地方以及刚刚发生的事情，即新教皇的就职典礼，以及J.D.

sentences.en: Vance is, like myself, a convert to Catholicism.
sentences.zh: 万斯和我一样，都是皈依天主教的人。

sentences.en: And there is this striking tension between where the Vatican, the Catholic bishops, the last pope, probably the new pope,
sentences.zh: 梵蒂冈、天主教主教们、上一任教皇，可能还有新任教皇，

sentences.en: tend to stand on immigration and Trump administration policy and generally the sort of populist attitude towards immigration in America and Europe.
sentences.zh: 在移民问题和特朗普政府政策，以及美国和欧洲普遍存在的民粹主义移民态度之间，存在着一种惊人的张力。

sentences.en: And briefly, what exactly is the Pope and the Catholic Church's view on immigration, in particular on how the United States should be thinking about immigration?
sentences.zh: 简而言之，教皇和天主教会对移民，特别是美国应该如何看待移民，到底持什么观点？

sentences.en: So the Catholic Church does not have a formal dogmatic stance on here's how many immigrants a just society has to admit and here's how many you're allowed to deport or anything like that,
sentences.zh: 天主教会并没有一个正式的教条立场说一个公正的社会必须接纳多少移民，或者你被允许驱逐多少人，诸如此类，

sentences.en: right?
sentences.zh: 对吧？

sentences.en: But then in practice, if you look at the rhetoric of Catholic bishops, the positions taken by Pope Francis and so on, the church leans, I think,
sentences.zh: 但在实践中，如果你看看天主教主教们的言论，教皇方济各等人的立场，我认为教会倾向于

sentences.en: pretty clearly in a more liberal direction on this issue and tends to be more critical of politicians who emphasize border security,
sentences.zh: 在这个问题上明显更偏向自由派，往往对强调边境安全的政客持更多批评态度，

sentences.en: more critical of politicians who emphasize deportations, and tends to stress pretty intensely the rights and dignity of migrants and their right to fair treatment.
sentences.zh: 对强调驱逐出境的政客持更多批评态度，并且往往非常强烈地强调移民的权利和尊严，以及他们获得公平对待的权利。

sentences.en: So even though there isn't, again, a sort of absolute position on this, there is a running tension as immigration has become this flashpoint in the Western world between where
sentences.zh: 所以即使再次强调，这并没有一个绝对的立场，但随着移民成为西方世界的一个爆发点，在

sentences.en: conservative politicians are, where populist politicians are, and where a lot of leaders of the church tend to be.
sentences.zh: 保守派政客、民粹主义政客和许多教会领袖的立场之间，存在着持续的张力。

sentences.en: So that's where we started with the vice president's own Catholicism
sentences.zh: 所以这就是我们从副总统本人的天主教信仰开始讨论的地方，

sentences.en: And then the always interesting and difficult relationship between American Catholic politicians and popes and the teachings of the church.
sentences.zh: 还有美国天主教政客与教皇及教会教义之间那种总是很有趣且复杂的关系。

sentences.en: I think there are sort of three ways of thinking about it, and I tend to fall in the middle.
sentences.zh: 我认为有三种思考方式，而我倾向于折中。

sentences.en: Okay, so way number one, and you see some Catholics or some Christians say this, is they'll say, well, politics is politics, policy is policy, religion is religion, and, you know,
sentences.zh: 好的，第一种方式，你看到一些天主教徒或基督徒会这么说，他们会说，政治归政治，政策归政策，宗教归宗教，你知道，

sentences.en: we wish the Pope all his best or we wish the church all its best in its moral teachings, but we got to focus on policy and these are two totally separate matters.
sentences.zh: 我们祝愿教皇一切顺利，或者祝愿教会在其道德教义上一切顺利，但我们必须专注于政策，这两者是完全分开的事情。

sentences.en: But I think that that's wrong because it understates the way in which all of us are informed by our moral and religious values.
sentences.zh: 但我认为这是错误的，因为它低估了我们所有人如何受到道德和宗教价值观的影响。

sentences.en: So that's not the right way to do it.
sentences.zh: 所以这不是正确的方法。

sentences.en: I think another way to do it would be to say, I'm just going to do everything the Holy Father tells me to do.
sentences.zh: 我认为另一种方法是说，我将完全按照圣父告诉我的去做。

sentences.en: I think that would be—
sentences.zh: 我认为那会——

sentences.en: Some people were worried about that with John F.
sentences.zh: 我记得有些人对约翰·F·

sentences.en: Kennedy, as I recall.
sentences.zh: 肯尼迪就有过这种担忧。

sentences.en: And I think that would be a violation of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我认为那将违反美国

sentences.en: Constitution.
sentences.zh: 宪法。

sentences.en: But certainly, I think just my obligation more broadly as a vice president to serve the American people, you've got to think about this stuff.
sentences.zh: 但当然，我认为作为副总统，我更广泛的义务是服务美国人民，你必须考虑这些事情。

sentences.en: But I think the way that I take it is, you know, on the migration question in particular, you have to think about what they've said.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我的处理方式是，你知道，特别是在移民问题上，你必须考虑他们说了什么。

sentences.en: And when the church says, you know, yes, we respect the right of a country to enforce its borders, you also have to respect the rights of migrants, the dignity of migrants,
sentences.zh: 当教会说，你知道，是的，我们尊重一个国家执行其边境政策的权利，你也必须尊重移民的权利，移民的尊严，

sentences.en: when you think about questions like deportation and so forth.
sentences.zh: 当你考虑驱逐出境等问题时。

sentences.en: And so you have to be able to hold two ideas in your head at the same time.
sentences.zh: 所以你必须能够同时在脑海中容纳两种观点。

sentences.en: And I'm not saying I'm always perfect at it, but I at least try to think about, okay,
sentences.zh: 我不是说我总是做得完美，但我至少尝试去思考，好吧，

sentences.en: there are obligations that we have to people who in some ways are fleeing violence or at least fleeing poverty.
sentences.zh: 我们对那些在某种程度上逃离暴力或至少逃离贫困的人负有义务。

sentences.en: I also have a very sacred obligation, I think, to enforce the laws and to promote the common good of my own country defined as the people with the legal right to be here.
sentences.zh: 我认为，我同时也肩负着一个非常神圣的义务，即执行法律，并促进我本国人民的共同利益，即那些有合法权利留在这里的人。

sentences.en: One issue in particular, you know, I've talked to a lot of cardinals this weekend just because there are a lot of cardinals here in Rome.
sentences.zh: 特别是一个问题，你知道，这个周末我与许多枢机主教交谈过，因为罗马这里有很多枢机主教。

sentences.en: And one of the arguments that I've made, you know, very respectfully, I've had a lot of good, respectful conversations,
sentences.zh: 我提出的一个论点是，你知道，非常恭敬地，我进行了许多良好、尊重的对话，

sentences.en: including with cardinals who very strongly disagree with my views on migration is that, you know, it's easy to get locked in sort of a left versus right.
sentences.zh: 包括与那些在移民问题上与我观点强烈不一致的枢机主教，那就是，你知道，很容易陷入左派与右派的对立。

sentences.en: You know, the left respects the dignity of migrants.
sentences.zh: 你知道，左派尊重移民的尊严。

sentences.en: The right is motivated by hatred.
sentences.zh: 右派被仇恨所驱使。

sentences.en: I think far too many people, obviously that's not my view, but I think some liberal immigration advocates get locked in that view that the only reason why J.D.
sentences.zh: 我认为太多人——显然那不是我的观点——但我认为一些自由派移民倡导者陷入了那种观点，认为J.D.

sentences.en: Vance wants to enforce the borders more stridently is because he's motivated by some kind of hatred or some kind of grievance.
sentences.zh: 万斯想要更严厉地执行边境政策的唯一原因是他被某种仇恨或某种不满所驱使。

sentences.en: And, you know, the point that I've tried to make is I think a lot about this question
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，我试图表达的观点是我非常关注这个问题，

sentences.en: of social cohesion in the United States.
sentences.zh: 即美国的社会凝聚力。

sentences.en: I think about how do we form the kind of society, again, where people can raise families, where people join in institutions together, where, you know,
sentences.zh: 我思考我们如何形成那种社会，再次强调，人们可以在那里抚养家庭，人们可以共同加入机构，在那里，你知道，

sentences.en: what I think Burke would have called the mediating layers of society are actually healthy and vibrant.
sentences.zh: 我认为伯克所称的社会中介层实际上是健康且充满活力的。

sentences.en: And I do think that those who care about what might be called the common good,
sentences.zh: 我确实认为那些关心所谓共同利益的人，

sentences.en: they sometimes underweight how destructive to the common good immigration at the levels and at the pace that we've seen over the last few years.
sentences.zh: 他们有时低估了过去几年我们所见的这种水平和速度的移民对共同利益的破坏性。

sentences.en: I really do think that social solidarity is destroyed when you have too much migration too quickly.
sentences.zh: 我真的认为，当移民过多过快时，社会团结就会被破坏。

sentences.en: And so that's not because I hate the migrants or I'm motivated by grievance.
sentences.zh: 所以这并不是因为我讨厌移民或被不满所驱使。

sentences.en: That's because I'm trying to preserve something in my own country where we are a unified nation.
sentences.zh: 这是因为我试图保护我自己的国家，使我们成为一个统一的国家。

sentences.en: And I don't think that can happen if you have too much immigration too quickly.
sentences.zh: 我不认为如果移民过多过快，这种情况还能发生。

sentences.en: And at that point, Ross, you ask the vice president how it is he measures whether or not the administration's immigration policies are actually working.
sentences.zh: 在那一点上，罗斯，你问副总统他是如何衡量本届政府的移民政策是否真正奏效的。

sentences.en: And Vance says that they've secured the border, but that when it comes to large-scale deportations, it's been more challenging.
sentences.zh: 万斯说他们已经稳固了边境，但当谈到大规模驱逐时，挑战更大。

sentences.en: And he specifically points to two obstacles, a lack of resources for enforcement, and then what he interprets as interference from the courts.
sentences.zh: 他特别指出了两个障碍：执法资源匮乏，以及他所理解的法院干预。

sentences.en: Yeah, that's right.
sentences.zh: 是的，没错。

sentences.en: I mean, look, it's—and I'm sure that New York Times listeners are going to be scandalized by this line of argumentation.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，看——我相信《纽约时报》的听众会对这种论点感到震惊。

sentences.en: But I think it's really important that in some ways the deportation infrastructure that is developed in the United States is not adequate to the task, given what Joe Biden left us.
sentences.zh: 但我认为非常重要的一点是，在某些方面，美国发展的驱逐基础设施不足以应对乔·拜登留给我们的烂摊子。

sentences.en: Now, there are different estimates here of how many illegal immigrants came in under the Biden administration.
sentences.zh: 现在，关于拜登政府期间有多少非法移民进入，有不同的估计。

sentences.en: Was it 12 million?
Was it 20 million?
Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we have a back and forth about this numbers specifically.
sentences.zh: 我们在这个数字上进行了来回讨论。

sentences.en: But it is absolutely the case that an unprecedented number of illegal immigrants did enter the U.S.
sentences.zh: 但绝对的事实是，在拜登政府期间，确实有前所未有的非法移民进入美国，

sentences.en: under the Biden administration that the Trump administration inherited.
sentences.zh: 这是特朗普政府所继承的。

sentences.en: And it did run, I think, very explicitly on a promise to deport a substantial number of those new arrivals and has, I think, can reasonably say it has a political mandate to do so.
sentences.zh: 我认为它确实非常明确地以承诺驱逐大量新移民为竞选纲领，而且我认为可以合理地说，它有政治授权这样做。

sentences.en: So the question is how?
sentences.zh: 所以问题是如何做？

sentences.en: there are two things that we can do.
sentences.zh: 我们可以做两件事。

sentences.en: I think one thing is a little bit easier and one thing is a little bit harder.
sentences.zh: 我认为一件事稍微容易一点，另一件事稍微难一点。

sentences.en: And the first thing is you just have to have the actual law enforcement infrastructure to make this possible.
sentences.zh: 第一件事是你必须拥有实际的执法基础设施来使之成为可能。

sentences.en: And again, I think that we should treat people humanely.
sentences.zh: 再次强调，我认为我们应该人道地对待人们。

sentences.en: I think we have an obligation to treat people humanely.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们有义务人道地对待人们。

sentences.en: But I do think that a lot of these illegal immigrants have to go back to where they came from.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为许多这些非法移民必须回到他们来的地方。

sentences.en: And that requires more law enforcement officers.
sentences.zh: 这需要更多的执法人员。

sentences.en: It requires more beds at deportation facilities.
sentences.zh: 这需要驱逐中心有更多的床位。

sentences.en: It just requires more of the basic nuts and bolts of how you run a law enforcement regime in the context of deportation.
sentences.zh: 这仅仅需要更多在驱逐背景下运行执法机制的基本要素。

sentences.en: That's one of the main things in the big, beautiful bill that is moving through Congress right now is more money for immigration enforcement.
sentences.zh: 这就是目前正在国会通过的那项宏大而美好的法案中的主要内容之一，即为移民执法提供更多资金。

sentences.en: That's what that money is for, to facilitate that deportation infrastructure.
sentences.zh: 这些钱就是为了促进驱逐基础设施建设。

sentences.en: There's a much more difficult question.
sentences.zh: 还有一个更困难的问题。

sentences.en: And I think you see the president's frustration.
sentences.zh: 我想你看到了总统的沮丧。

sentences.en: I've obviously expressed public frustration on this, which is, yes, illegal immigrants, by virtue of being in the United States, are entitled to some due process.
sentences.zh: 我显然对此表达过公开的沮丧，那就是，是的，非法移民因为身在美国，有权获得一定的正当程序。

sentences.en: OK.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: But the due process under a legislative stand to be clear.
sentences.zh: 但正当程序是基于立法标准的，明确一下。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: This is based on legislation like the judges who are making these decisions are not inventing this standard.
sentences.zh: 这是基于立法，比如做出这些决定的法官并不是在发明这个标准。

sentences.en: It is a legislative standard.
sentences.zh: 这是一个立法标准。

sentences.en: But the amount of process that is due and how you enforce those legislative standards and how you actually bring them to bear is I think very much an open question.
sentences.zh: 但应得的正当程序有多少，以及你如何执行这些立法标准，以及你如何真正实施它们，我认为这在很大程度上是一个悬而未决的问题。

sentences.en: And here, Vance brings up his frustration, shared no doubt by the president, with the level of due process that immigrants in the country illegally are still entitled to.
sentences.zh: 在这里，万斯提到了他的沮丧，毫无疑问总统也感同身受，即非法居留的移民仍然有权获得正当程序。

sentences.en: And I think that what you've seen, and I remember when I was in law school, there were all of these people who were wanting to become immigration lawyers.
sentences.zh: 我认为你所看到的是，我记得我在法学院时，有很多人想成为移民律师。

sentences.en: And there was almost a certain buzz around immigration law at the time because there was so much gray area.
sentences.zh: 当时移民法周围几乎有一种嗡嗡声，因为有太多的灰色地带。

sentences.en: There was so much open space where the courts would interpret how to apply these rules.
sentences.zh: 有太多的开放空间供法院解释如何应用这些规则。

sentences.en: Now, in the context of the United States in 2011, 2012, 13, when I was in law school, we had significant illegal immigration, but not that much.
sentences.zh: 现在，在2011年、2012年、2013年我上法学院时的美国背景下，我们有严重的非法移民，但没那么多。

sentences.en: There was this idea that you could use the asylum claim process and you could use the refugee process and you could use all of these other tools of the immigration enforcement regime to actually make it harder to deport illegal aliens.
sentences.zh: 当时有一种想法，你可以利用庇护申请程序，利用难民程序，利用移民执法机制的所有其他工具，来使驱逐非法外国人变得更加困难。

sentences.en: And then what happened is a lot of very well-funded NGOs went about the process of making it much harder to deport illegal aliens.
sentences.zh: 然后发生的事情是，许多资金充足的非政府组织着手让驱逐非法外国人变得更加困难。

sentences.en: And that's what we inherited in the year of our Lord 2025 is a whole host of legal rules.
sentences.zh: 而我们在2025年主之年所继承的，就是一大堆法律规则。

sentences.en: And in some cases, not even legal rules as much as arguments that had made by left-wing NGOs that hadn't actually been ruled on by the courts yet.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，甚至不是法律规则，而是左翼非政府组织提出的、法院尚未裁决的论点。

sentences.en: And what we're finding, of course, is that a small but substantial number of courts are just making it very, very hard for us to deport illegal aliens.
sentences.zh: 当然，我们发现的是，少数但相当数量的法院正在使我们驱逐非法外国人变得非常、非常困难。

sentences.en: And, you know, Stephen Miller, who, of course, is sort of our immigration czar in the White House, a good friend of mine, you know,
sentences.zh: 而且，你知道，斯蒂芬·米勒，他当然是我们在白宫的移民沙皇，我的好朋友，你知道，

sentences.en: he's thinking of all of these different and new statutory authorities, right?
sentences.zh: 他正在考虑所有这些不同且新的法定权力，对吧？

sentences.en: because there are a lot of different statutory authorities the president has to enforce the nation's immigration laws.
sentences.zh: 因为总统有很多不同的法定权力来执行国家的移民法。

sentences.en: And there is candidly frustration on the White House side that we think that the law is very clear.
sentences.zh: 白宫方面坦率地感到沮丧，因为我们认为法律是非常明确的。

sentences.en: We think the president has extraordinary plenary power.
sentences.zh: 我们认为总统拥有非凡的全面权力。

sentences.en: Yes, you have to, you need some process to confirm that these illegal aliens are in fact illegal aliens, not American citizens.
sentences.zh: 是的，你必须这样做，你需要一些程序来确认这些非法移民实际上是非法移民，而不是美国公民。

sentences.en: But that it's not like we're just throwing that process out.
sentences.zh: 但这并不意味着我们只是抛弃了那个程序。

sentences.en: We're trying to comply with it as much as possible and actually do the job that we were left.
sentences.zh: 我们正在尽最大努力遵守它，并切实完成留给我们的工作。

sentences.en: And let me just make one final sort of philosophical point here.
sentences.zh: 让我在这里提出最后一个哲学层面的观点。

sentences.en: I worry that unless the Supreme Court steps in here or unless the district courts exercise a little bit more discretion,
sentences.zh: 我担心，除非最高法院介入，或者除非地方法院行使更多的自由裁量权，

sentences.en: we're running into a real conflict between two important principles in the United States.
sentences.zh: 否则我们将在美国两个重要原则之间陷入真正的冲突。

sentences.en: Principle one, of course, is that courts interpret the law.
sentences.zh: 第一个原则当然是法院解释法律。

sentences.en: I think principle two is that the American people decide how they're governed, right?
sentences.zh: 我认为第二个原则是美国人民决定他们如何被治理，对吧？

sentences.en: That's the fundamental small-D democratic principle that's at the heart of the American project.
sentences.zh: 这是美国计划核心中那个基本的小写“d”民主原则。

sentences.en: I think that you are seeing, and I know this is inflammatory, but I think you are seeing an effort by the courts to quite literally overturn the will of the American people.
sentences.zh: 我认为你正在看到——我知道这很具煽动性——但我认为你正在看到法院在字面上推翻美国人民意愿的努力。

sentences.en: And to be clear, it's not most courts, but I think what the Supreme Court has to do, and I saw an interview with Chief Justice Roberts recently where he said,
sentences.zh: 需要明确的是，并非大多数法院都是这样，但我认为最高法院必须做的是——我最近看了首席大法官罗伯茨的一次采访，他说，

sentences.en: the role of the court is to check the excesses of the executive.
sentences.zh: 法院的角色是制衡行政部门的越权行为。

sentences.en: I thought that was a profoundly wrong sentiment.
sentences.zh: 我认为这种观点是大错特错的。

sentences.en: That's one half of his job.
sentences.zh: 那是他工作的一半。

sentences.en: The other half of his job is to check the excesses of his own branch.
sentences.zh: 他工作的另一半是制衡他自己部门的越权行为。

sentences.en: And you cannot have a country where the American people keep on electing immigration enforcement and the courts tell the American people they're not allowed to have
sentences.zh: 你不可能拥有这样一个国家：美国人民不断投票支持移民执法，而法院却告诉美国人民他们不被允许拥有

sentences.en: what they voted for.
sentences.zh: 他们投票支持的东西。

sentences.en: And that's where we are right now.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们现在的处境。

sentences.en: We're going to keep working it through the immigration court process through the Supreme Court as much as possible.
sentences.zh: 我们将继续通过移民法院程序和最高法院尽可能地推进这项工作。

sentences.en: And look, my hope is that when you ask what success is, success to me is not so much a number, though obviously I'd love
sentences.zh: 听着，我的希望是，当你问什么是成功时，对我来说，成功与其说是一个数字——尽管显然我很乐意

sentences.en: to see the gross majority of the illegal immigrants who came in under Biden deported.
sentences.zh: 看到拜登任内进入的大多数非法移民被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: That actually is a secondary metric of success.
sentences.zh: 那实际上是一个次要的成功指标。

sentences.en: Success to me is that we have established a set of rules and principles that the courts are comfortable with and that we have the infrastructure to do that
sentences.zh: 对我来说，成功在于我们建立了一套法院认可的规则和原则，并且我们拥有能够做到这一点的基础设施，

sentences.en: allows us to deport large numbers of illegal aliens when large numbers of illegal aliens come into the country.
sentences.zh: 使我们能够在大量非法移民进入该国时将他们驱逐出境。

sentences.en: That, to me, is real success.
sentences.zh: 对我来说，那才是真正的成功。

sentences.en: But I think whether we're able to get there is a function, of course, of our efforts, but also of the courts themselves.
sentences.zh: 但我认为我们能否实现这一目标，当然取决于我们的努力，但也取决于法院本身。

sentences.en: Ross, the vice president here seems to be arguing for a judiciary that is more responsive to the will of the people when it comes to immigration,
sentences.zh: 罗斯，副总统在这里似乎在主张建立一个在移民问题上更能响应民意的司法机构，

sentences.en: which is not traditionally how we have seen the role of the courts.
sentences.zh: 这在传统上并不是我们所看到的法院的角色。

sentences.en: I mean, the whole point of having lifetime appointments,
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，实行终身任职制的全部意义在于，

sentences.en: I'm not telling you anything you don't know, is that judges are insulated from public whiMs.
sentences.zh: 我不是在告诉你不知道的事情，那就是法官要与公众的反复无常隔绝开来。

sentences.en: Their job is to interpret the Constitution, interpret longstanding precedent, regardless of what the public thinks.
sentences.zh: 他们的工作是解释宪法，解释长期以来的先例，而不论公众怎么想。

sentences.en: But you get the sense that what Vance really wants is for judges to get out of the way and get to a yes to the Trump administration
sentences.zh: 但你感觉到万斯真正想要的是让法官们不要阻碍，并对特朗普政府的要求说“是”，

sentences.en: regardless of what previous interpretations of a law might be because that's what he says the American voters want.
sentences.zh: 而不论法律之前的解释可能是什么，因为他说这就是美国选民想要的。

sentences.en: I think the context for the vice president's argument is sort of twofold.
sentences.zh: 我认为副总统论点的背景大致有两个方面。

sentences.en: One, there is a longstanding perspective in American conservatism that judges and Supreme Court justices are too quick to interfere in democratic politics
sentences.zh: 第一，美国保守主义中有一种长期存在的观点，即法官和最高法院大法官太快干预民主政治，

sentences.en: to sort of impose their interpretations of the Constitution that are themselves quite debatable, rather than deferring to the executive and legislative
sentences.zh: 从而强加他们自己对宪法的解释，而这些解释本身就很有争议，而不是尊重行政和立法

sentences.en: branches, which do, in fact, represent public opinion more directly than the judiciary does, absolutely.
sentences.zh: 部门，这些部门实际上比司法部门更直接地代表公众舆论，绝对是这样。

sentences.en: And then the other backdrop to this is that over a long period of time, especially in Western Europe, you have had this really striking dynamic where public opinion
sentences.zh: 另一个背景是，在很长一段时间里，特别是在西欧，你看到了一个非常引人注目的动态，即公众舆论

sentences.en: is very skeptical and critical of mass immigration.
sentences.zh: 对大规模移民非常怀疑和批评。

sentences.en: And yet, in some cases, the judiciary, in some cases, the bureaucracy, in some cases, prime ministers and other leaders have found ways to basically ignore public sentiment.
sentences.zh: 然而，在某些情况下，司法机构、官僚机构，以及总理和其他领导人，已经找到了基本上无视公众情绪的方法。

sentences.en: And much of European politics has been defined by voters trying to vote against mass immigration, not getting the policy they want, and then moving
sentences.zh: 欧洲政治的很大一部分被选民试图投票反对大规模移民、却得不到他们想要的政策，然后转向

sentences.en: towards further right and populist parties, like Marine Le Pen's national rally in France, like the alternative for Deutschland in Germany.
sentences.zh: 更右翼和民粹主义政党所定义，比如法国玛丽娜·勒庞的国民联盟，德国的德国选择党。

sentences.en: Vance is drawing on the perspectives of European politics, this sense that the public has a desire and elites are always trying to thwart it.
sentences.zh: 万斯正在借鉴欧洲政治的观点，即公众有愿望，而精英们总是试图阻挠它。

sentences.en: And judges throwing up roadblocks to the Trump administration doing deportations are part of that tradition.
sentences.zh: 而法院为特朗普政府进行驱逐出境设置障碍，正是这一传统的一部分。

sentences.en: So there are two obvious ways that an administration frustrated by the pace of deportations could try and address those frustrations.
sentences.zh: 因此，一个对驱逐出境速度感到沮丧的政府可以尝试通过两种明显的方式来解决这些挫折。

sentences.en: One is to try and directly change the law that governs due process for illegal immigrants.
sentences.zh: 一是尝试直接修改管理非法移民正当程序的法律。

sentences.en: Or you could look at judicial interpretations of that law that you think have been too favorable
sentences.zh: 或者你可以审视你认为对非法移民过于有利的法律司法解释，

sentences.en: to illegal immigrants and present test cases to the Supreme Court, a Supreme Court that is friendly to executive power, and try and get those interpretations changed.
sentences.zh: 并向最高法院提出测试案例——一个对行政权力友好的最高法院——并试图改变这些解释。

sentences.en: I think the administration is doing some version of both of those things, but then they also have a third track that they're pursuing.
sentences.zh: 我认为政府正在做这两件事的某种版本，但他们还有第三条轨道正在推进。

sentences.en: And we will discuss that third track, which happens to be the most controversial track, after the break.
sentences.zh: 我们将在休息后讨论那第三条轨道，这恰好是最具争议的轨道。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: I'm Winnalou.
sentences.zh: 我是温纳洛。

sentences.en: I write the game connections, one of the puzzles from New York Times games, and I love horror movies.
sentences.zh: 我编写游戏《Connections》，这是《纽约时报》游戏中的谜题之一，我喜欢恐怖电影。

sentences.en: I love my dog, and I love trying to trick you.
sentences.zh: 我爱我的狗，我也喜欢试图捉弄你。

sentences.en: I'm Sam Mazursky, and I create the game Spelling Bee and Letterboxd on a daily basis.
sentences.zh: 我是萨姆·马祖斯基，我每天创作游戏《Spelling Bee》和《Letterboxd》。

sentences.en: And I have this thing called promesthesia.
sentences.zh: 我有一种叫做“联觉”的东西。

sentences.en: I see color when I'm listening to music.
sentences.zh: 我在听音乐时能看到颜色。

sentences.en: New York Times games are made by people, like the ones you just heard from.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》的游戏是由人制作的，就像你刚才听到的那些人一样。

sentences.en: Go to nytimes.com slash games to start playing today.
sentences.zh: 前往 nytimes.com/games 今天就开始玩吧。

sentences.en: Okay, Ross, before the break, you told us that the administration's options for speeding up the pace of deportations is first, rewrite the law.
sentences.zh: 好的，罗斯，休息前你告诉我们，政府加快驱逐出境速度的选项首先是重写法律。

sentences.en: Second, get the Supreme Court to reinterpret the law or to use a third option.
sentences.zh: 第二，让最高法院重新解释法律，或者使用第三个选项。

sentences.en: So talk about what Vance says that third option is.
sentences.zh: 那么谈谈万斯所说的那个第三个选项是什么。

sentences.en: So the third option.
sentences.zh: 所以，第三个选项。

sentences.en: This has obviously been the zone of maximal controversy under Trump.
sentences.zh: 这显然是特朗普治下争议最大的领域。

sentences.en: The idea that you can claim some sort of wartime power
sentences.zh: 这种想法是你可以声称拥有某种战时权力，

sentences.en: that lets you deport illegal immigrants either without any due process at all or with a kind of extremely minimal due process.
sentences.zh: 让你可以在完全没有正当程序，或者只有极低限度的正当程序的情况下驱逐非法移民。

sentences.en: So it's sort of like the Trump administration is looking for a kind of wartime powers hack for this larger challenge of not having the legal infrastructure necessary for mass deportation.
sentences.zh: 所以这就像特朗普政府正在为缺乏大规模驱逐所需法律基础设施这一更大的挑战寻找一种“战时权力”的捷径。

sentences.en: It's basically like we have this big challenge,
sentences.zh: 这基本上就像我们面临这个巨大的挑战，

sentences.en: but what if there was one neat trick in a law from the 1790s that would let us avoid having to go through all the trouble of passing new legislation or establishing new Supreme Court precedents?
sentences.zh: 但如果1790年代的法律中有一个巧妙的技巧，让我们不必经历通过新立法或建立新最高法院先例的所有麻烦，那会怎样？

sentences.en: So I asked him about that.
sentences.zh: 所以我问了他这个问题。

sentences.en: Just to push – there's a third track too, which is using existing legal authorities that haven't been used in the past but we think are there.
sentences.zh: 只是想追问一下——还有第三条轨道，那就是使用过去没有使用过但我们认为存在的现有法律授权。

sentences.en: And this is what I'm asking about.
sentences.zh: 这就是我所问的。

sentences.en: The legal authorities that you guys have tried to use have been the particular one is the Alien Enemies Act, right?
sentences.zh: 你们试图使用的法律授权，特别是《外籍敌侨法》，对吧？

sentences.en: Which is an extremely aggressive claim about wartime powers that, as far as I can tell, even under the most aggressive interpretation,
sentences.zh: 这是一种关于战时权力的极其激进的主张，据我所知，即使在最激进的解释下，

sentences.en: is likely to apply only to an incredibly small number of migrants, right?
sentences.zh: 也可能只适用于极少数的移民，对吧？

sentences.en: You're not – the claim is not actually that five million migrants here illegally are in a state of war against the United States.
sentences.zh: 你并不是——主张并不是说这里非法居住的五百万移民正处于与美国战争的状态。

sentences.en: Or is that the claim?
sentences.zh: 还是说这就是主张？

sentences.en: No, it's not that five million are engaged in like military conflict, but that the – I take issue that it's an aggressive interpretation.
sentences.zh: 不，并不是说五百万人在进行军事冲突，而是——我不同意这是一种激进的解释。

sentences.en: So let me back up and take some issue with the premise.
sentences.zh: 所以让我退后一步，对这个前提提出一些异议。

sentences.en: I don't think that the supposition, if you look at the history and the context of those laws, is that for something to be an invasion,
sentences.zh: 我不认为，如果你看看这些法律的历史和背景，假设要成为一种“入侵”，

sentences.en: you have to have like five million uniformed combatants.
sentences.zh: 就必须有五百万穿制服的战斗人员。

sentences.en: Yes, we don't have five million uniformed combatants.
sentences.zh: 是的，我们没有五百万穿制服的战斗人员。

sentences.en: But Ross, I mean, this is where I think I have to be careful here because some of this information, of course, is classified.
sentences.zh: 但是罗斯，我的意思是，这就是我认为我必须小心的地方，因为其中一些信息当然是机密的。

sentences.en: But I think how to put this point.
sentences.zh: 但我认为该如何表达这一点。

sentences.en: I think that the courts need to be somewhat deferential.
sentences.zh: 我认为法院需要表现出一定的尊重。

sentences.en: In fact, I think the design is that they should be extremely deferential to these questions of political judgment made by the people's elected president of the United States.
sentences.zh: 事实上，我认为设计初衷是他们应该对美国人民选举产生的总统所做的政治判断问题表现出极大的尊重。

sentences.en: Because when you say, well, there aren't 5 million people who are waging war, okay, but are there thousands, maybe tens of thousands of people?
